eval_cases.description: UC 1.1: Single-turn hardware recovery SOP for Toshiba TCx 810 EMV contactless freeze (ERR-PAY-4001).

parts.text: What is the immediate field recovery protocol when a cashier encounters an ERR-PAY-4001 EMV contactless payment freeze, and how do we ensure the customer is not double-charged?

To recover from an ERR-PAY-4001 EMV payment freeze on the Toshiba TCx 810: 1. Do not re-swipe or recharge immediately to prevent double charging. 2. Hold Yellow + # on the PIN pad for 3 seconds to reboot the payment module. 3. Check 12V PoweredUSB cabling. 4. Open Manager Menu -> Journal Audit Slip to check transaction status. If AUTHORIZED_UNSETTLED, print receipt slip; if VOIDED_ERROR, re-scan items and request card presentation. Reference manual: https://storage.cloud.google.com/cymbal-ops-runbooks/pos_manual_toshiba_tcx810.pdf

eval_cases.description: UC 1.1: Diebold Nixdorf BEETLE A1150 thermal printer cutter lockup error (ERR-DN-PRNT-24V).

parts.text: How do store clerks resolve a terminal thermal printer cutter lock error code ERR-DN-PRNT-24V on a Diebold Nixdorf BEETLE A1150?

For Diebold Nixdorf BEETLE A1150 error ERR-DN-PRNT-24V (cutter knife lockup): 1. Turn off printer power before manual manipulation. 2. Open printer cover and rotate manual feed knob counter-clockwise to retract the cutter blade. 3. Clear jammed paper shreds and perform test feed. Link: https://storage.cloud.google.com/cymbal-ops-runbooks/diebold_nixdorf_beetle_a1150_service.pdf
